name: Mizukoshi Maika
source: Mizukoshi Maika is a medic in charge of public health in the Kazami school. Mizukoshi hospital is her familial enterprise. In addition, she is working in a research institute of Professor Amakase, leading the researches dedicated to the creation of robots. She also takes care of awakened Minatsu. Maika has a good sense of humor and sometimes loves to tease Yoshiyuki. According to some rumors, she is a niece of Mizukoshi Moe and Mako (the daughter of their younger brother, Tomoya). Heavy smoker.
